agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Approval of annual report and financial statements for fiscal year 2025. The shareholders approved the report, granted full acquit et de charge to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, with 100% of shares (6,913,859,700) in favor.
Agenda #2: Approval of use of net profit. The comprehensive profit of Rp65,914,559,998 was allocated with Rp1,000,000,000 as a reserve fund and the remainder as retained earnings; no cash dividend was declared, with unanimous shareholder approval.
Agenda #3: Determination of remuneration and allowances for Directors and Commissioners. The Board of Commissioners was authorized to set remuneration, honorarium, and other allowances for the 2026 fiscal year, with 100% of shares (6,913,846,700) in favor.
Agenda #4: Approval of Public Accountant appointment. The Board of Commissioners was delegated authority to appoint a Public Accountant registered with the Financial Services Authority to audit the 2026 financial statements, approved with 100% of votes.
Agenda #5: Approval of report on use of funds from public offering. The accountability for the realization of public offering proceeds was accepted, granting full acquit et de charge to the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners, with approval.
Agenda #6: Change of Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners composition. The resignation of Independent Commissioner I Ketut Widiana was approved (effective at meeting closing), waiving the 90-day notice requirement, and Hinca Ikara Putra Panjaitan was appointed as his replacement, with the new term until 28 November 2027; approved with 100% in favor.
